name: Constellations
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the Creator of the heavens and all their constellations, including Arcturus, Orion, Pleiades, and the crooked serpent, demonstrating His sovereign power over the cosmos (Job 9:9; Job 26:13). The stars and constellations, while magnificent, do not possess independent power to give light or influence, as Isaiah 13:10 emphasizes their light will fail, pointing believers to trust in the Lord alone. Amos 5:8 calls us to seek the Creator who controls both the celestial bodies and the natural order, affirming that the LORD alone is sovereign over all creation.
